definitions.assignment: 1/red assigns ego to red and partner to blue; 2/blue does the reverse
definitions.initial: Effective assignment on the first transition of each round; a policy choice in v1_matched and influence-enabled v3, an environment default in v2
definitions.final: Effective assignment on the terminal transition of each round, including timeouts
definitions.switch: Change in effective assignment after initialization and within the same round; initialization and changes across round resets are excluded
definitions.course: Rounds 1–20 within one partner episode; the partner capability stays constant across those rounds
definitions.weighting: Per seed, equal episode and round weights; all profiles have twenty episodes. Thick overview lines average all five seeds equally
definitions.faster_task: Partner assigned its lower-delay color, excluding equal-delay profiles; not a geometry-aware optimality claim

caveats: All training seeds are included; none is selected or dropped.
No-influence assignment is externally imposed; ego requests do not determine it.
V1_matched is fixed within a round but may choose differently between rounds.
V2 initial assignments are random defaults. V3 has learned initial choices only for influence-enabled policies.
Raw assignment arrays, rather than historical initial-allocation summary fields, determine initial choices.
These figures describe saved evaluation behavior, not behavior during PPO training.
No confidence intervals are shown; individual seed trajectories show training-run variability.
